proposed_widenings.name: Attachment.item_or_object for non-spell activations
proposed_widenings.justification: The carpet's mechanical subject is the existing magic item itself, not the user or a spawned creature. Current non-spell activations only reach self/target/area/mark creature-style attachments.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You can make this carpet hover and fly by taking a Magic action

proposed_widenings.name: command_existing_item_movement
proposed_widenings.justification: The surface has command semantics only for spawned companions. Carpet of Flying needs a reusable way to direct an already-existing item's movement within a control radius, with speed depending on load.
proposed_widenings.evidence: It moves according to your directions if you are within 30 feet of it.

proposed_widenings.name: load_threshold predicate for movement modifiers
proposed_widenings.justification: The item's speed changes when carried weight exceeds normal capacity but stays within double capacity. Existing predicates only cover HP thresholds, not carried-load thresholds.
proposed_widenings.evidence: its Fly Speed is halved if it carries more than its normal capacity

notes: No content file authored. The size table could fit existing magic-item variants, but the core mechanic still needs item/object attachment plus commandable-item movement and load-gated speed changes.
